messages.content: You are a careful judge. You decide which of two responses to a question is correct.

response.text: {"reasoning": "Both responses build a cost graph and run Dijkstra per source-target pair. Response B precomputes per-character adjacency with minimum edge costs, so each Dijkstra only iterates outgoing edges. Response A scans all transformations each time a node is popped, which is inefficient and can time out given up to 10^5 positions and 2000 entries. Both handle start==end and unreachable cases. Correctness-wise both compute valid shortest paths, but B's implementation is more appropriate and avoids the severe performance flaw. Therefore B is the better/correct response.", "winner": "B"}
